question: A pyramid with an equilateral triangular base of side 10 cm and height 14 cm is placed on top of a cube with side length 10 cm. Find the total volume of the composite solid.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Volume = Volume of Cube + Volume of Pyramid

⇒ Total Volume = (side)³ + (1/3) × (√3 / 4 × base²) × height

⇒ Total Volume = 10³ + (1/3) × (√3 / 4 × 100) × 14

⇒ Total Volume = 1000 + (350√3 / 3) ≈ 1000 + 202.07

⇒ Total Volume = 1202.07 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1202.07 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the cube (a) = 10 cm

Side of the equilateral triangular base of the pyramid (b) = 10 cm

Height of the pyramid (h) = 14 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cube = a³

Area of an equilateral triangle = (√3 / 4) × b²

Volume of a pyramid = (1/3) × Base Area × height

 
 
• 10 cm 10 cm h = 14 cm Equilateral Base = 10 cm Composite Solid: Cube + Pyramid 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of the cube = 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000 cm³

⇒ Area of the pyramid's base = (√3 / 4) × 10² = 25√3 cm²

⇒ Volume of the pyramid = (1/3) × 25√3 × 14 = (350√3) / 3 cm³

⇒ Substituting the approximate value of √3 ≈ 1.732:

⇒ Volume of the pyramid ≈ (350 × 1.732) / 3

⇒ Volume of the pyramid ≈ 606.2 / 3 ≈ 202.07 cm³

⇒ Total Volume = Volume of the cube + Volume of the pyramid

⇒ Total Volume = 1000 + 202.07 = 1202.07 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1202.07 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Pyramid

Volume = (1/3) × Base Area × Height. This formula is universally applicable to any pyramid, regardless of the 2D shape of its base (square, triangle, hexagon, etc.).

Area of an Equilateral Triangle

Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a², where a is the length of the side. In an equilateral triangle, all three sides are equal in length, and each internal angle measures 60°.

Volume of a Cube

Volume = a³, where a is the side length. A cube is a special type of right prism where all six faces are identical squares.
